sentences.l2: 飞机能在天上飞，是因为工程师用了很多物理知识。
sentences.l1: Airplanes can fly in the sky because engineers have used a lot of physics knowledge.

sentences.l2: 飞机的翅膀是特别设计的。
sentences.l1: The wings of an airplane are specially designed.

sentences.l2: 当飞机向前跑，空气从翅膀上下两边流过。
sentences.l1: When the airplane runs forward, air flows past the two sides of the wing, above and below.

sentences.l2: 翅膀上面的空气流得快，下面的空气流得慢。
sentences.l1: The air above the wing flows fast, and the air below flows slowly.

sentences.l2: 这样就会产生一种向上的力，我们叫它“升力”。
sentences.l1: This produces an upward force, which we call "lift."

sentences.l2: 升力让飞机离开地面，飞上天空。
sentences.l1: Lift makes the airplane leave the ground and fly up into the sky.

sentences.l2: 但是空气也会挡住飞机的路。
sentences.l1: But the air also blocks the airplane's path.

sentences.l2: 这种挡住飞机的力叫“阻力”。
sentences.l1: This force that blocks the airplane is called "drag."

sentences.l2: 阻力会让飞机变慢。
sentences.l1: Drag makes the airplane slow down.

sentences.l2: 所以飞机的形状要做得光滑，这样空气才能顺利流过，减少阻力。
sentences.l1: So the shape of the airplane must be made smooth, so that the air can flow past smoothly and drag is reduced.

sentences.l2: 引擎的作用就是产生向前的推力，帮助飞机克服阻力。
sentences.l1: The function of the engine is to produce forward thrust, helping the airplane overcome drag.

sentences.l2: 飞行时，工程师要让升力、阻力、推力和重力这四个力保持平衡。
sentences.l1: During flight, engineers must keep the four forces of lift, drag, thrust and gravity in balance.

sentences.l2: 如果升力太大，飞机会上升；如果升力太小，飞机会下降。
sentences.l1: If lift is too great, the airplane will rise; if lift is too small, the airplane will descend.

sentences.l2: 如果推力不够，飞机就会变慢，甚至飞不动。
sentences.l1: If thrust is not enough, the airplane will slow down, and may even be unable to move.

sentences.l2: 所以飞行员和工程师都要懂这些物理原理，才能让飞机安全飞行。
sentences.l1: So pilots and engineers both have to understand these physical principles, in order to let the airplane fly safely.

sentences.l2: 现代飞机设计要用到很多工程计算和风洞实验。
sentences.l1: Modern airplane design needs a lot of engineering calculation and wind tunnel experiments.

sentences.l2: 工程师先做小模型，放在风洞里吹风，看空气怎么流过。
sentences.l1: Engineers first make a small model, put it in a wind tunnel and blow air on it, to see how the air flows past.

sentences.l2: 他们观察升力和阻力的变化，再改进设计。
sentences.l1: They observe the changes in lift and drag, and then improve the design.

sentences.l2: 这个过程会重复很多次，直到飞机飞得又快又稳又安全。
sentences.l1: This process is repeated many times, until the airplane flies fast, steady and safe.

sentences.l2: 虽然飞行看起来很复杂，但其实都是由简单的物理规律控制的。
sentences.l1: Although flight looks very complicated, it is in fact all controlled by simple physical laws.

sentences.l2: 懂了这些规律，我们就能造出更好的飞机。
sentences.l1: Once we understand these laws, we can build better airplanes.
